lines.en: I fly along the forest's bright patches.
My pink wings open and close.
I glide a long way between wingbeats.
I am the fastest flier in the jungle.
I skirt the vines and climb to the canopy.
A wing brushes a leaf.
I ride a warm current.
I weave between the trunks.
Big wings carry me far.
I pause, then lift off again.
The flowers are that way. I know.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在草上，很小。
lines.en: My shadow on the grass is tiny.

lines.zh: 我绕着同一棵树转了圈。
lines.en: I circle the same tree.
I dislike overcast days.
I skim across the water.
A little wing dust has rubbed off.

lines.zh: 我停在虞美人的花瓣上。
lines.en: I rest on a poppy's petal.

lines.zh: 翅膀合起来，只剩一条线。
lines.en: Wings closed, I am only a line.
Sun makes my pink brighter.

lines.zh: 我在暖石头上歇一会儿。
lines.en: I rest on a warm stone.
When the wind blows, I must hold on.
My antennae probe.
The jungle is loud.

lines.zh: 我翅膀上的纹路像眼睛。
lines.en: The marks on my wings look like eyes.
I wait for the sun to rise higher.
The dew has not dried.
My proboscis sits coiled like a spring.
This leaf is too slick.
Your shadow is enormous.
You are blocking my flowers.
I perch on top of your hat.

lines.zh: 你的手指太粗，抓不住我。
lines.en: Your fingers are too thick to hold me.

lines.zh: 你手里那个网，我看见了。
lines.en: I see the net in your hand.
I fly faster than you can turn.
I have landed on your hat brim.
Your breath stirs the flowers.

lines.zh: 我记着你眼睛动的方向。
lines.en: I track the way your eyes move.
These flowers will keep me till dusk.
One wing is bent.
My flight has gone crooked.
Much of my dust is gone.
I land and cannot rise.

lines.zh: 我半边翅膀抬不起来了。
lines.en: Half a wing will not lift.
I cannot beat my wings.

lines.zh: 我一根触角垂着，不听使唤。
lines.en: One antenna hangs and will not obey.

lines.zh: 我把翅贴在背上不敢动。
lines.en: I press my wings flat and freeze.
I am still breathing.
Do not crush me.
Is that a poppy?
That red draws me helplessly.
I settle on the flower's heart.
I taste something sweet.
Do not move. I am feeding.

lines.zh: 我翅上的粉会沾到花上。
lines.en: My dust will dust the flower.

lines.zh: 这朵花活得更久了，因为我。
lines.en: This flower lives longer because of me.
One more flower.

lines.zh: 我从远处就闻到这朵的蜜。
lines.en: I smelled this one's nectar from afar.
The one in your hand smells best.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀被你碰偏了方向。
lines.en: Your nudge bends my course.
Your bump flips me over.
My wings are fragile.
I climb away quickly.
Do not put your hand out.
My wings give out; I rest on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一下我的粉掉了很多。
lines.en: A lot of my dust came off.
We nearly collided.
I have gone around you.
You are too wide. You block the way.
I look for wings as pink as mine.
Only above the canopy can we see clearly.
We fly a long way together.

lines.zh: 树叶背面是产卵的地方。
lines.en: The underside of a leaf is where eggs go.
This is not for living things to watch.
I circle half the canopy.
Still searching.
You cannot help with this.
I rise higher.

lines.zh: 我翅上的花纹是给同族看的。
lines.en: My patterns are for my own kind.

lines.zh: 我落在上面，它也撑得住。
lines.en: I land on it, and it holds.
I gather a little with my feet.
This is not nectar.
One taste and I am off.
That is a fleck of salt.
My feet are too fine for this.
I let it fall.
Its color is close to mine.
I test it with my forelegs.
No. I do not need it.
I am airborne.

lines.zh: 你在什么下面我都能看见。
lines.en: I see you from any angle.
I do not attack. I only evade.
False eyes sit on my wings.
I jink up and down.
You will not catch me.

lines.zh: 我很快就能飞出这片林子。
lines.en: I can clear this wood quickly.
High up, I blur.
I hide my wings behind the blooms.
I stopped just to fool you.
I keep climbing.
When your hand lifts, I move.
I skim the canopy.
You are coming the wrong way.
I am on a petal.
I hop from flower to flower.
My wings are whispering.
The sun is at my back.
You cannot see me from below.
I will fly a while longer.
I beat my wings at you.
Nothing came of that.
Wing dust gets in your eye.

lines.zh: 我只会用翅粉迷你的眼。
lines.en: All I can do is dust your eyes.
I bump your hand once.
I can only fly higher.
Did I startle you?
I am light as paper.
That made you sneeze.
One beat, and I am into the flowers.
I flutter out from under a leaf.
The jungle is warm today.

lines.zh: 我的颜色在阳光里很亮。
lines.en: My color glows in the sun.
I cross a patch of flowers.
The dew has just dried.
I circle a poppy.
Wind up in the canopy.
My wings are still new.

lines.zh: 早上的光把我照成粉色。
lines.en: Morning light turns me pink.
There are enough flowers here.

lines.zh: 火气一下就把我的翅膀烤卷了。
lines.en: The heat curls my wings at once.

lines.zh: 我从树冠掉下来，摔在落叶上。
lines.en: I drop from the canopy onto the leaves.

lines.zh: 我的翅一沾水就沉得像布。
lines.en: Wet, my wings sink like cloth.
The blast slaps me onto a trunk.
A thorn pierces my wing.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的翅粉乱飞。
lines.en: That light scatters my dust.
Without flowers I will not last.

lines.zh: 雷光把我的翅膀照透了。
lines.en: Lightning makes my wings translucent.
No flowers here, and no light.
